tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: The Commandant shall improve maritime domain awareness in the Arctic—

children.text: by promoting interagency cooperation and coordination;
by employing joint, interagency, and international capabilities; and
by facilitating the sharing of information, intelligence, and data related to the Arctic maritime domain between the Coast Guard and departments and agencies listed in subsection (b).

tree.heading: Coordination.—
tree.text: The Commandant shall seek to coordinate the collection, sharing, and use of information, intelligence, and data related to the Arctic maritime domain between the Coast Guard and the following:

children.text: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
Any Federal agency or commission or State the Commandant determines is appropriate.

tree.heading: Cooperation.—
tree.text: The Commandant and the head of a department or agency listed in subsection (b) may by agreement, on a reimbursable basis or otherwise, share personnel, services, equipment, and facilities to carry out the requirements of this section.

tree.heading: 5-year Strategic Plan.—
tree.text: Not later than January 1, 2016 and every 5 years thereafter, the Commandant shall submit to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate and the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure of the House of Representatives a 5-year strategic plan to guide interagency and international intergovernmental cooperation and coordination for the purpose of improving maritime domain awareness in the Arctic.

tree.heading: Definitions.—
tree.text: In this section the term “Arctic” has the meaning given that term in section 112 of the Arctic Research and Policy Act of 1984 (15 U.S.C. 4111).

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 154 of this title as this section.
